categories.label: No report: managed in the quality system
categories.rule: No submission: the change is managed and documented under CGMP and the quality system.

categories.label: Letter to the application (no supplement)
categories.rule: Tell FDA by letter; no supplement is needed.

categories.label: Annual report
categories.rule: Make the change, then describe it in the next annual report, due within 60 days of the anniversary of approval.

categories.label: Supplement - Changes Being Effected
categories.rule: Distribute product made with the change when FDA receives the supplement.

categories.label: Supplement - Changes Being Effected in 30 Days
categories.rule: Distribute product made with the change 30 days after FDA receives the supplement, unless FDA tells you within those 30 days that prior approval is needed or that information is missing.

categories.label: Prior approval supplement
categories.rule: Distribute product made with the change only after FDA approves the supplement.

categories.label: New application
categories.rule: File a new application (an NDA, or an ANDA for a generic) and market the new product only after approval.

multipleChanges.rule: When related changes are filed together, use the most restrictive category of the individual changes.

changeLog.text: First edition: 73 changes for NDAs, ANDAs and BLAs, from the 2004 guidance on changes to an NDA or ANDA, SUPAC-IR for composition, the 2021 biologics guidance, the 2022 comparability protocol guidance and the labeling rules in 314.70 and 601.12.
